paragraphs: CollegeNET builds enterprise software that helps colleges and universities manage academic scheduling, event scheduling and campus operations. The platform also covers admissions and resource management. Its flagship Series25 platform supports course scheduling, room and space management, academic calendars and campus event coordination.

Series25 is meant to eliminate double bookings and automate communication so space is used efficiently across departments. CollegeNET has been Workday's scheduling partner since 2019. The site says more than 50 institutions are connected through the automatic, bi-directional LYNX interface for Workday. A newer product, Connect25, manages student organizations natively inside 25Live.

The company says it has been dedicated exclusively to serving higher education institutions for more than 40 years. It states that its work reaches over 1,000 colleges and universities worldwide. The software requires no installation or maintenance by campus IT staff. CollegeNET states that it adheres to Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards and is SOC2 compliant. One customer story says Doane University cut events scheduling time in half with 25Live.

quote.text: Get full control over your academic and event scheduling.
